description: This file contains a series of shell functions and tests for handling errors and operations related to git p4, a Git interface for Perforce. It sets up testing scenarios such as starting p4d, adding files to p4, handling authentication errors, and testing ticket logout functionality.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to Perforce for version control.

methods.name: p4 login
methods.description: Logs in a user to Perforce and manages tickets.

methods.name: p4 logout
methods.description: Logs out a user from Perforce, invalidating tickets.
